svg.title: SLIs
svg.desc: Checkout requests pass through the load balancer, which logs every one. Bot traffic is not counted. Each valid request is checked: no error and under 300 ms is good, anything else is bad. The good and bad counts tick up and the SLI, good divided by valid, ends at 497 out of 500, or 99.4 percent.
svg.text: Each valid request is judged good or bad. The SLI is the good share.
